 "content": "---
name: arc-hollow-rectangle-parity-fill
description: Use when ARC grids contain hollow rectangular frames. Infer interior fill from frame dimensions, then preserve the rest.
---

# ARC hollow-rectangle parity fill

## Trigger
Use for ARC-style grids with several hollow, axis-aligned rectangular outlines on a uniform background, especially when training examples show small and large frames being filled with two recurring colors.

## Inferred rule from examples
1. Find each rectangular frame by its non-background border color; identify its bounding box and verify the border is continuous.
2. Do not recolor the border or the external background.
3. Fill the strict interior according to its dimensions: examples support color **7** when the interior side lengths are odd, and color **2** when the interior side lengths are even. For square examples, this is simply odd interior width/height -> 7; even -> 2.
4. A 3x3 frame has a 1x1 interior and therefore gets a 7 at its center. A 5x5 frame has a 3x3 interior and gets 7. A 4x4 frame has a 2x2 interior and gets 2; a 6x6 or 8x8 frame also has an even-sized interior and gets 2.
5. Apply independently to every frame, retaining all other pixels unchanged. If non-square or mixed-parity interiors appear, use a new demo rather than assuming how the parity rule generalizes.

## Evidence and caution
Observed in demonstrations with background colors 5, 6, and 9 and frame colors including 0, 3, 4, 6, 8, and 9. The border color and background color do not determine the fill; interior dimensions do. Check all frames, including frames whose centers contain a contrasting pixel, and overwrite the full interior consistently. This is an empirical task-family rule, not a universal ARC rule.",

description: Use when hollow ARC rectangles may be filled by interior-size parity.

# Hollow rectangle interior parity

Use when a grid contains hollow axis-aligned rectangular outlines on a uniform background and examples associate two fill colors with dimensions.

## Procedure
1. Locate each complete rectangular outline by its non-background border color; record its bounding box.
2. Leave borders and all cells outside the boxes unchanged.
3. Compute strict interior dimensions: interior height = box height - 2; interior width = box width - 2.
4. From the observed demos for this task family, fill interiors with 7 when both interior dimensions are odd, and with 2 when both are even. In the examples, 1x1 and 3x3 interiors map to 7; 2x2, 4x4, and 6x6 interiors map to 2.
5. Apply independently to every frame. Overwrite any pre-existing center/interior marks as part of the fill.

## Evidence and limits
The demonstrated grids had varying backgrounds and border colors, while the fill was determined by the interior size. The tested rule included square frames only; do not extrapolate to mixed-parity or non-square interiors without further examples. Keep all unrelated pixels unchanged.",
